headline: Private Equity Firm GTCR Explores Potential Acquisition of Global Payments
summary: Private equity group GTCR disclosed in a regulatory filing that it is exploring a potential takeover of transaction processor Global Payments, sending the company's shares up 10%.
why: Global Payments is a major U.S. financial technology firm offering payment processing infrastructure for businesses globally.

impacts.name: Global Payments
impacts.why: Takeover interest from private equity firm GTCR lifted the company's equity valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory disclosures revealing private equity buyout interest drove Global Payments stock up 10%.
